notes.title: Galaxy squad announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I am very happy to announce my new project, Galaxy squad! 
I've been working on it for quite a lot of time, and I'm ready to finally reveal it. 

Galaxy squad is turn-based tactical game, kinda like mix between XCOM and FTL! You are leading a group of characters across randomly generated galaxy, encounter different story events and fight in hardcore tactical battles.

Check out the announcement trailer:

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4MVWPO1Dv4o

And check out steam store page for more info: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/921710/Galaxy_Squad/

Add it to your wishlists and share it with your friends! I am planning to release the game into Early Access at the end of the year!

notes.title: Putrefaction 2 on Greenlight!
notes.notes:
Hi guys! I am happy to announce that my new game Putrefaction 2 is on Steam Greenlight! This is a sequel to my first game, and I want to make this one right.

The game will be very different and improved experience, compared to first title. It is now much more fast-paced, open and colorful shooter, however it still retains impactful and gory gunplay from original. I am aiming to fix all mistakes I had previously and I hope everyone will enjoy this game even more. 

Please vote for it:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=805837428
